title: Sequence Onset Filtering (stim_num==1) & 100-Trial Equalized Resampling Across All Raster Suites
notes: Root Cause Identified: Raw NWB interval tables contain 4 sub-stimulus rows per sequence trial (p1, p2, p3, p4), causing un-filtered raster generators to plot ~1000 event rows instead of ~100 sequence trials.
Sequence Onset Filtering: Applied stim_num == 1.0 filter across all session epoch queries to extract true sequence trial onset triggers (P1).

Equalized 100-Trial Resampling Policy: Standardised all 4 condition raster subplots (RRRR, RXRR, RRXR, RRRX) to show exactly N=100 trials (y-limits 0 to 100). Conditions with N > 100 are randomly sampled without replacement; conditions with N < 100 are resampled with replacement.

Re-rendered all PNG raster suites across outputs/raster_suites/mt_mst_splus/, outputs/raster_suites/mt_mst_sminus/, outputs/raster_suites/oplusplus/, outputs/raster_suites/v182o_fef51_similar/, and outputs/raster_suites/v198o_fef51_similar/.
